platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.seoDescription: Paste a public Facebook video or Reel link into ReelFetch. Download a listed quality when Facebook returns a file. Private posts are not saved.
platforms.headline: Download public Facebook videos and Reels
platforms.intro: Use ReelFetch when you have a public Facebook watch, Reel, or video link and you are allowed to keep a copy. The tool shows only the qualities that link returns.
steps: Open the public Facebook video or Reel and copy its link.
Paste the link on the ReelFetch homepage and choose Find Video.
Select a listed quality, then save the file with your browser.
platforms.note: fb.watch and facebook.com/share links are accepted when they resolve to a public video. A recognized link can still fail if the post is private, removed, or region-limited.

faqs.question: Which Facebook links can ReelFetch check?
faqs.answer: Public watch, Reel, and video links, including fb.watch addresses that point at a public video. Private posts and login-only videos are not downloaded.

faqs.question: Does every Facebook link include Full HD?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch lists the formats Facebook returns for that link. Full HD appears only when that video actually offers it.

faqs.question: Is ReelFetch affiliated with Facebook?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch is an independent tool and is not endorsed by Meta or Facebook.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.seoDescription: Check a public YouTube video or Shorts link and save a quality YouTube provides. Private, deleted, and blocked videos are not downloaded.
platforms.headline: Download public YouTube videos and Shorts
platforms.intro: Paste a public YouTube or youtu.be link to see the download options that video exposes. ReelFetch does not bypass private videos, age gates you cannot pass, or region blocks.
steps: Copy the public YouTube video or Shorts URL.
Paste it into ReelFetch and choose Find Video.
Download one of the qualities shown for that video.
platforms.note: YouTube may change which formats a video offers. If a quality is missing from the list, ReelFetch cannot invent it.

faqs.question: Can I download a YouTube Short the same way as a normal video?
faqs.answer: Yes, when the Short is public. Paste the Shorts link, review the listed qualities, and download one of them.

faqs.question: Will every YouTube link be downloadable?
faqs.answer: No. Private, deleted, members-only, and geographically restricted videos can fail even when the URL looks valid.

faqs.question: Is ReelFetch an official YouTube app?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.seoDescription: Paste a public TikTok video link to see the file options ReelFetch can prepare. Private accounts and removed clips are not downloaded.
platforms.headline: Download public TikTok videos
platforms.intro: ReelFetch checks public TikTok video links and lists a file when TikTok provides one. Photo posts, private accounts, and deleted clips are outside what this page promises.
steps: Copy the link of a public TikTok video.
Paste it on ReelFetch and choose Find Video.
Save a listed file to your browser downloads.
platforms.note: A TikTok URL proves the address shape, not that a video file is still public.

faqs.question: Can I download a TikTok video with ReelFetch?
faqs.answer: You can try any public TikTok video link. ReelFetch downloads a file only when that clip is available to the lookup.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch keep a copy of TikTok videos?
faqs.answer: No. The file is prepared for your download and temporary server data is discarded after the transfer.

faqs.question: Are private TikTok accounts supported?
faqs.answer: No. Log in on TikTok if you need to view private content. ReelFetch does not access private accounts.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.seoDescription: Check a public Instagram Reel or video post and download a quality Instagram returns. Private accounts and restricted posts are skipped.
platforms.headline: Download public Instagram Reels and videos
platforms.intro: Paste a public Instagram Reel or video post link. ReelFetch shows download choices only when that post exposes a video file. Private profiles are not retrieved.
steps: Copy the link of a public Reel or video post.
Paste it into ReelFetch and choose Find Video.
Download a quality that appears in the result.
platforms.note: Stories and private posts are not promised. If Instagram does not return a file, ReelFetch will not create one.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch download Instagram Reels?
faqs.answer: Public Reels can be checked. You get a file only when Instagram returns one for that link.

faqs.question: Can private Instagram posts be saved?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch does not log into Instagram and does not download private or restricted posts.

faqs.question: Is ReelFetch part of Instagram?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch is an independent downloader and is not sponsored by Instagram or Meta.

platforms.name: X
platforms.seoDescription: Paste a public X or Twitter post link that contains video. ReelFetch lists a download when that post returns a video file.
platforms.headline: Download public videos from X
platforms.intro: ReelFetch accepts public x.com and twitter.com links. It can prepare a file when the post contains video. Text-only posts and protected accounts do not produce a download.
steps: Copy the link of a public post that includes video.
Paste the x.com or twitter.com URL into ReelFetch.
Choose Find Video, then save a listed quality.
platforms.note: Recognizing an X link only means the address is on X. The post still has to contain a public video.

faqs.question: Do both x.com and twitter.com links work?
faqs.answer: Yes. ReelFetch recognizes public links on both host names and checks them for video.

faqs.question: Can I download a post that is only text or images?
faqs.answer: No. This page is for posts that contain a video file. Image-only posts are not turned into video.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch represent X?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch is not affiliated with or endorsed by X.

platforms.name: Pinterest
platforms.seoDescription: Check a public Pinterest video pin, including pin.it links. Static image pins are not converted into video downloads.
platforms.headline: Download public Pinterest video pins
platforms.intro: Paste a public Pinterest or pin.it link when the pin contains video. ReelFetch lists a file only if that pin returns video media.
steps: Copy the public pin link from Pinterest or pin.it.
Paste it into ReelFetch and choose Find Video.
Download a quality if the result lists one.
platforms.note: Image pins, idea pins without a video file, and private boards are not downloadable videos.

faqs.question: Can ReelFetch download Pinterest videos?
faqs.answer: Public pins that contain video can be checked. The download exists only when Pinterest returns a video file.

faqs.question: Will an image pin become an MP4?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch does not turn a still image into a video.

faqs.question: Are pin.it short links accepted?
faqs.answer: Yes. Short pin.it links are recognized and then checked like other public Pinterest URLs.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.seoDescription: Paste a public Reddit post with video, including redd.it links. ReelFetch prepares a file when that post exposes video media.
platforms.headline: Download public Reddit videos
platforms.intro: ReelFetch checks public Reddit and redd.it links that contain video. Text posts, image posts, and private communities do not produce a video file.
steps: Copy the link of a public Reddit post that plays video.
Paste it into ReelFetch and choose Find Video.
Save a listed file. Audio is included when the source provides it.
platforms.note: Some Reddit videos store picture and sound separately. A combined file is available only when the server can prepare one from what Reddit returns.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch download Reddit videos?
faqs.answer: Public video posts can be checked. You receive a file only when the post still exposes video media.

faqs.question: Are redd.it links supported?
faqs.answer: Yes. Short redd.it links are recognized and checked the same way as reddit.com posts.

faqs.question: Is every Reddit post a video?
faqs.answer: No. Links, images, and text posts are not downloaded as video.
